correctness.rationale: For each windmill, exact apex deletion and link are joins of simplex skeletons. Each skeleton has free integral homology given by the exterior power of its augmentation kernel. The link inclusion is null by the dimension/connectivity gap, giving a two-degree sphere wedge. The natural deletion-link long exact sequence and graded join Künneth identify the full integral automorphism action; return permutations give the trace formula. A standalone checker performed twelve exhaustive mod-two chain computations and 92 selected signed Lefschetz comparisons and 1,416 additional exhaustive group-element comparisons, all passing. They corroborate but do not prove the unrestricted statement.
